findings.evidence: SELF-CLOSED within round 2 at commit bbc07aedf ('test-e2e(rush-hour wave-B round-2): fix idem-key length 422 cascade'). Original defect: round-2 spec built X-Idempotency-Key as `${INSTRUCTION_PREFIX}-${seq}-${TS}-IDK-${crypto.randomUUID()}` = 67-69 chars, exceeding IdempotencyKeyMiddleware regex /^[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{8,64}$/. Round-3 env (F-001/D-009) had flipped IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED=true, making the regex active for /api/frontend/order. All 38 burst orders died at stage=store with HTTP 422 MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, B-001 unverifiable. Fix landed: compact key `WAVE-B-{seq}-{TS_last7}-{8hex}` ~30 chars, traceability preserved. Post-fix verification: wave-B-api-order-results.json shows 38/38 store stage 200, 38/38 payment-confirm 200; state 12 console.json shows 0 application 422 echoes (vs round-1 pre-fix 25× 422); api_payment_confirm_ok=38 (was 0). Self-corrected without external intervention.
findings.fix_hint: Closed (commit bbc07aedf). Defensive follow-up: add an in-spec self-assertion `if (idemKey.length > 64) throw new Error('idem key length regression — re-tune key template');` so future template changes fail fast.
